notes.title: Steam Deck & Linux Support is now live!
notes.content: [h2]NEW[/h2][list][*][p][b]Linux Support[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Support[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]General Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]Best Score[/b]: Added a best score counter for the top score achieved during the session.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Score Display[/b]: Large scores now display with comma formatting for better readability (e.g., 1,234,567).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Over Delay[/b]: Added 2-second delay before allowing restart to prevent accidental restarts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b]: Improved gamepad device support.[/p][/*][*][p][b]YYC Compiler[/b]: Switched from VM to YYC compiler for improved performance across all platforms.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Fixed Steam Achievement Bug[/b]: "First Time Player" achievement now properly unlocks on first game launch.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Steam Deck Optimisations[/h2][list][*][p]Native 1280x800 fullscreen support.[/p][/*][*][p]Proper text scaling for 7" display readability.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The patch notes can also be read on the [url="https://5yearsnow.com/games/The-Last-of-the-9-Lives/patch/v1.1"]5 Years Now[/url] website.[/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Ascending Realms: RTS x Autobattler Demo + Kickstarter Now Live!
notes.content:
My next game is here—try the demo now!

From the creator of The Last of the 9 Lives, Ascending Realms is a fantasy RTS with autobattler combat, focused on macro strategy over APM. Think Warcraft 3 meets Mega-lo-Mania, with hero units, tech trees, loot, neutral enemies, and deep planning.

🎮 Play the free demo on Itch.io or Steam (coming soon):
[url=https://sharkie21.itch.io/ascending-realms]Ascending Realms Itch.io Demo[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3635950/Ascending_Realms_Demo/]Ascending Realms Steam Demo[/url]

🚀 The Kickstarter campaign is now live!
Back us to help bring the game to Early Access:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dr-sharkie/ascending-realms-rts-autobattler-hybrid]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dr-sharkie/ascending-realms-rts-autobattler-hybrid[/url]

🧭 Wishlist Ascending Realms on Steam:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3635950/Ascending_Realms/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3635950/Ascending_Realms/[/url]

💬 We’re taking feedback, bug reports, and suggestions on our Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/URsQvAdYRN]https://discord.gg/URsQvAdYRN[/url]

Thanks for checking it out, and I hope you enjoy the early taste of the game. Your support means a lot!
